issues.explanation: No test files are included in the diff despite new models, policies, controller, and three Livewire components.
Domain writes in Members and Settings act directly on Eloquent instead of going through app/Actions classes.
Public input properties lack #[Validate] attributes and use inline validate calls instead of the project's #[Validate] plus $this->validate pattern.
Public input properties in Settings lack #[Validate] attributes despite being validated inline.
assignRole permits changing the owner membership to admin or employee, which can leave the entity with zero owners outside transfer.
Members view references ui.add_member which is not defined in either locale file, so the add button renders the raw key.
Session clearing uses strict identity comparison that can miss when the stored id type differs, leaving stale current_entity_id.
English locale reuses Portuguese labels for nav_members and nav_settings instead of English text.
CHANGELOG.md is not updated despite new domain behavior.
Remove-member role check mixes enum and string access in one convoluted expression.
Unused Auth import remains in the controller.
Leftover drafting comment about the duplicate message remains in addMember.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:99 missing #[Validate]; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:203 missing #[Validate]; no app/Actions classes for addMember/assignRole/removeMember/save/delete/transfer

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:161 convoluted role->value ?? role check; app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:14 unused Auth import; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:120 leftover comment

requirements.evidence: database/migrations owner_seq storedAs plus entity_memberships_one_owner; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:16 view/update/manageSettings; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:250 transfer checks plus DB::transaction; docs/database-schema.md updated; routes entity.pick/dashboard/members/settings present

scope.evidence: all new files map to task contract: Entity, EntityMembership, UserRole, policies, factories, migrations, Livewire pages, routes, lang, docs; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:134 scoped findOrFail plus Gate::authorize assignRole/delete; app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:200 #[Locked] entity plus Gate::authorize manageSettings; app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:25 403 before session put; gap at app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:132 owner demotion allowed

simplicity.evidence: lean direct Eloquent calls reuse membershipFor, policies, Rule::unique ignore; no new service layers or abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff contains zero test files; no Pest/PHPUnit coverage including required unauthorized-call and tamper tests

review.summary: The change implements the full entity data model, policies, pick endpoint, Livewire pages, routes, lang keys, and schema docs. It is blocked by zero shipped tests and deviations from Actions and #[Validate] conventions, plus an assignRole path that can demote the owner.
